comment.body:
Closing without merging following review.

**Rejection category:** `technical`
**Reviewed head:** `5b5b0957a476a8bddc119f582ad59691409cbad6`

**Reason:** The white open-ring mark has been replaced by a transparent cutout. As a result, the mark almost disappears on a dark background. The selected safari-pinned-tab.svg is a mask intended for a different rendering context, and the PR statement "same white open-ring C" does not match the final SVG.

**Required follow-up for the maintenance agent:** Find a suitable original vector that preserves the intended white mark and works on both light and dark backgrounds. Do not repair the pinned-tab mask by arbitrarily filling its holes. If no suitable original vector can be established, do not propose this replacement.

This decision is based on `bank-icons-audit-2026-10-06.md`, `bank-icons-review-2026-10-05.pdf`, and `bank-icons-crosscheck-2026-10-05.pdf`, with the audit corrections taking precedence over unsupported cross-review claims.

[Supporting evidence](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/02795fe5d81a5bb066c2a8c398eb2bf03c14ffda/review-materials/4803/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

This rejection applies to this candidate, not permanently to the bank. A fresh proposal must resolve the specific defect above.
